correctness.rationale: The proof uses the cyclic endpoint of a positive Jacobi matrix, an exact rank-one Lyapunov identity which forces a real-state T=alpha/gamma+beta*gamma law, reflection symmetry alpha=m, and a fixed-size strong-loss Schur complement. Singular vectors of the reduced odd SSH chain give 2(m-1)a^2/b^2+(b/a)^(2m-2) exactly. Computer replay passed 276 independent finite numerical and symbolic checks, not used as an infinite proof. Domain includes m=1.

originality.rationale: The evaluated all-m, all-positive-parameter exact single-endpoint SSH time and optimized exponential/linear dichotomy is neither the known uniform-path formula nor a corollary of the inspected continuous-time quantum walk measurement, infinite periodic sublattice-loss, or homogeneous impurity scattering results.
